name: Chaos black and white feedback
says: The mixer loop run at negative gain and inverted, on a channel tuned 0.2 MHz off its carrier.

name: Wonkitize me
says: A composite loop 2.9µs long, ringing at 0.8 MHz, closed over an archive film.

name: I can't believe it's not analog butter
says: Chroma gain at sixteen times, the loop delayed 1.7µs and pulled off its timebase.

name: Wiggity
says: A 32 kHz oscillator laid over the picture, with the deflection bent by a Lorenz attractor.

name: Fuzzy color bars feedback+dissolver
says: A sync regenerator slicing into picture, over a camera loop and 9 IRE of ground hum.

name: Dark camera feedback
says: A tape path with dropouts, wow and a head switch, into a camera loop at three times gain.

name: Laser duck
says: Arcs striking the picture at 120 IRE while the supply sags 5µs.

name: Rainborb
says: A camera loop just over unity, turned 1.5° a lap, with the iris hunting.

name: Ridiculous rainbow
says: A composite loop keyed on itself, 0.4µs of delay turning the hue every lap.

name: Camera feedback + static
says: FM over-deviation on the tape path, with the vertical oscillator drifting under it.

name: Collecting dust
says: A camera loop with the read clock 1.5% out and the bus clipping.

name: Fuzzy color bars feedback
says: A camera loop at 0.73, defocused, settling on colour bars.

name: Ponderorb
says: A camera loop turned 3.2° a lap, resonating at 1.35 MHz.
